semantics: GET /api/v3/market/recent-resources/:realmId/ returns { resources: Array<{ kind: number }> }. The exchange quick-access bar in the original client calls Dpr(realmId) = GET /api/v3/market/recent-resources/${realmId}/ and iterates data.resources. If shadowed by /api/v3/market/:realmId/:kind/ (which returns an array of market orders []), data.resources is undefined and accessing data.resources.some() throws an unhandled TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'some').
